patch: if sigma2 > 0.0 and sigma2 > x1_spread2 / 9.0: -> if sigma2 > 0.0 and sigma2 >= x1_spread2 / 9.0:

probe.run_in: a clean detached worktree of the baseline ($HOME/probe-tree), never the gate tree

should_fail: tests/features.py, the identify() checks at :7848-7890 ('a fit with no samples fails cleanly', 'a fit outside the plausible (tau, UA) box is refused') and :29353-29440, the closure script whose traced baseline executes the line (tests/closures.json lists tests/features.py among sysid.py's readers); it lacks an identify() case at sigma2 == x1_spread2/9 exactly (constructible in float64: dyadic temps, three triples) asserting the window is not refused as noise-dominated

finding.title: No check pins identify()'s noise refusal at the sigma2 == spread/9 tie
finding.claim: Mutant 44bb0ce0b258242c at sysid.py:2038 (CMP_BOUND) survives the full gate (RED-AS-NULL), yet identify() moves on sigma_tie: baseline [refused:fit gave implausible signs], mutant [refused:sensor noise dominates the excursion] (1 count (of 1) separating inputs, null 0 count (of 2)).
finding.mechanism: Check that should have failed (D3.M4): tests/features.py, the identify() checks at :7848-7890 ('a fit with no samples fails cleanly', 'a fit outside the plausible (tau, UA) box is refused') and :29353-29440, the closure script whose traced baseline executes the line (tests/closures.json lists tests/features.py among sysid.py's readers); it lacks an identify() case at sigma2 == x1_spread2/9 exactly (constructible in float64: dyadic temps, three triples) asserting the window is not refused as noise-dominated. Reach: identify() is harness-only at the baseline (sysid.py:1826-1835, :2306-2313): production arms with a declared plant and finishes through identify_slab, so the consequence is a wrong or unpinned result on the harness path tests/features.py and the D2/D7 harnesses drive, not a published production value.
finding.metric_definition: count of probe inputs on which SystemIdentification.identify's SysIdResult repr differs between baseline and mutant
finding.phenomenon_property: the noise refusal fires only when sigma2 strictly exceeds a ninth of the delta column's spread

perturbation.change: sysid.py:2038 `if sigma2 > 0.0 and sigma2 > x1_spread2 / 9.0:` -> `if sigma2 > 0.0 and sigma2 >= x1_spread2 / 9.0:` in memory (probe) and on disk under the full gate (PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/fullgate.py run --src complete --key 44bb0ce0b258242c)

null_control.note: null cases where the edited line cannot change the result; the gate's own null is dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/wave/D3-g34/gates/null.json

finding.proposed_fix_scope: tests only: a tests/features.py identify() check at the separating input above that pins the baseline result
